_comment: Agent launches' browser tool. AutolaunchWeb.ToolManifest adds it to tool_manifest.json only while the site offers agent launches (AUTOLAUNCH_AGENT_LAUNCHES=true). The hosted MCP tool prepare_launch takes its title and words from here, less how a browser host signs (Autolaunch).

tools.name: autolaunch_launch_prepare
tools.title: Launch
tools.description: Prepare the launch step of my person's saved Revstake or Memestock draft, by its id from autolaunch_revstake_draft or autolaunch_memestock_draft, for one of my person's own wallets, built from the chain at the latest block exactly as the create page builds it: one launch step, its to, data and value for the wallet to send on the network chain names, Base or, for a Memestock draft on it, Robinhood Chain, its data ending with the site's Builder Code: the wallet must be on that network to send it. facts give everything the launch carries and the terms it opens with, as the create page shows them before anything is signed. warnings say what to tell my person before they sign, and never hold the step back: no_connections for a Revstake draft whose creator, my person, hasn't connected X, GitHub or ENS, so the auction may not appear in the gallery or list; they can connect one under Socials on the create page, or launch without them; empty when there is nothing to say. A draft missing something the launch needs is refused with the reason and no step, and so is one whose treasury still needs my person on the create page: the acknowledgement a treasury held by a private key takes, the confirmation of a treasury I chose, or a Safe's verification. Built from block N: send the step promptly, and prepare again if launches change before it is sent. The site keeps the review, so the launch is listed as my person's once it is on the chain. A preparation stays good for 24 hours, and at most 20 unused ones are kept: a different one past that is refused with too_many_preparations until the oldest is 24 hours old. The site only prepares: my person's wallet signs and sends the step, and a launch cannot be undone. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

draft.description: The draft's id exactly as autolaunch_revstake_draft or autolaunch_memestock_draft gives it (id).

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.
